stories.title: Albertans reject separation by a wide margin in a historic referendum, a boost for PM Carney
stories.reason: Unofficial Elections Alberta counts show roughly 75% backing staying in Canada versus 25% for starting a path toward a binding separation vote, with Carney saying 'Albertans made a clear choice' even as separatist leaders vow to keep fighting.

stories.title: Zelensky meets Trump envoy Witkoff in Oslo as Ukraine accuses the Pentagon of holding up paid-for Patriot interceptors
stories.reason: Jared Kushner joined remotely due to illness as Zelensky reportedly offered a 30-day halt on strikes against Russian refineries in exchange for the missiles, while Washington denies deliberately delaying the shipment Hegseth has yet to sign off on.

stories.title: A single hacker used AI agents to breach more than 100 company websites for about $5,000 in token costs
stories.reason: A Reuters investigation found the Chinese-speaking operator directed agents built on the exposed open-source Cairn platform against 1,200 targets including Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins, needing fewer than 100 characters of instructions per attack.

stories.title: DHS orders DeepSeek products removed from all federal civilian agency systems
stories.reason: The exclusion order, issued under the 2018 federal supply-chain security law, cites fears Beijing could access DeepSeek infrastructure to harvest personal data, and gives agencies 60 days to request exceptions through CISA.

stories.title: OpenAI is reportedly in talks to raise $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation ahead of Anthropic's expected IPO
stories.reason: The pre-IPO round, more than 60% above OpenAI's $852 billion valuation from March, would reportedly draw interest from Abu Dhabi's MGX and BlackRock as the company tells investors annualized revenue has reached $50 billion.

stories.title: A Russian drone strike on the Kyiv-Odesa highway kills three people and wounds four
stories.reason: Prosecutors say the strike set multiple cars ablaze near a shopping center outside Kyiv, with a regional official noting the victims were ordinary commuters 'simply on their way to work.'

stories.title: Finland plans to buy one million anti-personnel landmines for about €100 million, citing the Russian threat
stories.reason: PM Petteri Orpo's government wants domestic manufacturers to produce the mines by 2028, following Finland's withdrawal from the Ottawa Treaty alongside Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Poland over a 'worsening security climate.'

stories.title: Microsoft rolls out Project Perception tools treating AI agents as potential insider threats
stories.reason: New Microsoft 365 E7 features give each agent its own identity, continuously score its risk, and can strip permissions or halt it entirely, with 'Guardian Agents' reviewing actions before execution across 60 detectable agent types.
